# docs-pr-gate composite-doc allowlist
#
# Each line is `<src-prefix> <doc-path>` (space-separated). When a PR
# touches a `src/application/{commands,primitives}/…` file under one of
# these prefixes AND the matching <doc-path> is also touched (or is
# already present in `docs/use/primitives/README.md` as a row), the
# gate suppresses the per-file mismatch.
#
# Use this when a multi-file primitive ships as a single composite user-
# facing surface (mental-model primer + operator catalogue) rather than
# one page per file. Document the exemption inline here so reviewers can
# audit the trade-off.
#
# Lines beginning with `#` are comments; blank lines are ignored.

# Phase 20.1 — snapshot+join engine. The ~20 building blocks compose
# into `repo.snapshot.*` + `join`/`innerJoin` + the operator catalogue,
# all documented in docs/use/snapshots.md + docs/understand/caching.md.
src/application/primitives/snapshot/ docs/use/snapshots.md
src/application/primitives/snapshot-operators/ docs/use/snapshots.md

# Primitives that are NOT bound on `repo.primitives.*` and so have no
# per-file page by design: their reference is the composite
# `docs/use/primitives/internals.md`, which carries one entry each for
# `buildPack`, `fetchPack`, `createPackRegistry` and the config-write
# helpers. The gate looks for `<basename>.md` or the funnel README and
# cannot see that page, so without these lines every touch of one of them
# reports drift against a page that was never supposed to exist.
#
# This suppresses the per-file mismatch only when `internals.md` is itself
# in the PR's changed set — so it still forces the question "does the
# composite page need updating?" rather than silencing it outright.
src/application/primitives/build-pack.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/fetch-pack.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/pack-registry.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/update-config.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
# `validators.ts` is the odd one out: guard predicates and refusal-reason
# constants with no user-facing surface of their own. Each guard is
# described where it actually bites (the command or registry entry that
# enforces it), so `internals.md` remains the right place to look.
src/application/primitives/validators.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md

# Same rationale, added by the git-parity-containment change: each of these
# is either exported from the primitives package but not bound on
# `repo.primitives.*` (compare-working-tree-entry.ts), not exported from the
# package at all (apply-merge-to-worktree.ts), or already an internals.md
# resident from an earlier phase (apply-changeset.ts, build-index-from-tree.ts,
# synthesize-tree-from-index.ts). `types.ts` carries shared interface
# definitions with no page of its own — same rationale as validators.ts above,
# each type is documented on the primitive page that returns/accepts it.
src/application/primitives/apply-changeset.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/apply-merge-to-worktree.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/build-index-from-tree.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/compare-working-tree-entry.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/synthesize-tree-from-index.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
src/application/primitives/types.ts docs/use/primitives/internals.md
